title: Formula for Veronese fraction generators
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], an invertible module L [def-sc-invertible-module], a natural number d, and a homogeneous section s of degree d of its section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring], let g be the explicit numerator-to-fraction map [def-sc-section-ring-veronese-fraction-map]. Its quotient by the relation submodule [def-sc-section-fraction-presentation] is an additive equivalence, by its proved surjectivity and the kernel equality [lem-sc-section-ring-veronese-fraction-kernel]. Define sectionRingVeroneseFractionEquiv to be the inverse of this fixed quotient equivalence. If e equals sectionRingVeroneseFractionEquiv X L d s, then for each n>=0 and xi in S_(n*d), e(xi/s^n) is the section-fraction generator [n,T_n(xi_(n*d))], with T_n the exponent-commutativity, tensorPowMulIso and inverse-left-unitor isomorphism. This is the canonical constructed map, not an arbitrary additive equivalence.

proof.text: Construct the additive quotient equivalence with QuotientAddGroup.liftEquiv applied to the explicit direct-sum map, its proved surjectivity, and its kernel equality. Define sectionRingVeroneseFractionEquiv to be its unique inverse.

Substitute the equality hypothesis. Apply injectivity of the inverse equivalence to the claimed generator formula. The quotient map evaluates on a generator by DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of; sectionRingVeroneseNumerator_cancel cancels the tensor-power isomorphism and degree injection. The remaining equality is reflexive.

theorem sectionRing_veronese_fraction_formula
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d)
    (e : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≃+
      SectionFractionPresentation (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d))
    (he : e = sectionRingVeroneseFractionEquiv X L d s) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
      e (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
        ξ.val ξ.property) =
      sectionFraction (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d) n
        ((eqToIso (congrArg L.tensorPow (by simp [Nat.mul_comm])) ≪≫
          L.tensorPowMulIso d n ≪≫ (λ_ _).symm).hom.app ⊤ (ξ.val (n • d)))
